castello de la plana.summary: A UJI resident survey shows that 57.5% rated Castelló de la Plana as safe or completely safe, while 10.3% considered it unsafe.

el grau.summary: El Grau records highlight community concerns regarding repeated nighttime break-ins and illegal squatting attempts, though police have made arrests, reinforced patrols, and intervened following resident tip-offs.

grapa.summary: Grapa features a poorly equipped skatepark and has experienced reported robberies, leaving residents feeling insecure due to insufficient police presence.

grupo san agustin.summary: In a UJI resident survey, 3.9% of responses identifying unsafe places named Grupo San Agustín.

la guinea.summary: A resident survey showed 20.4% of responses identified Barrio de La Guinea as an unsafe place, alongside a reported civic grievance regarding a meeting venue.

marjaleria.summary: While paths are described as tranquil despite navigation challenges, residents report attempted home intrusions and broader insecurity concerns.

parque del oeste.summary: In a UJI resident survey, 5.8% of responses identifying an unsafe place named Parque del Oeste.

parque ribalta.summary: Travelers call Parque Ribalta an ideal, calm green space for walking, but a resident survey identified it as an unsafe place by 36.9% of responses.

plaza mayor.summary: Casco Histórico is viewed as a clean and charming area with a good atmosphere and no mentioned safety caveats, despite a noticeable change between day and night.

rafalafena.summary: Residents opposed removing park fencing due to fears of night insecurity and street-drinking, though this reflects a planning dispute rather than confirmed crime.

raval universitari.summary: Raval Universitari faces resident complaints regarding drug dealing, assaults, and squatting, and is cited as requiring extra caution at night.

san lorenzo.summary: A 2025 resident survey showed that 27.2% of responses identifying an unsafe place named Barrio de San Lorenzo.
